metadata.title: Regelvakt – obligations and deadlines for small businesses
metadata.description: See which obligations and deadlines your sole proprietorship or limited company has towards the Norwegian Tax Administration and the Brønnøysund Register Centre, with sources, a calendar and reminders.

footer.notAdvice: Regelvakt is not tax or accounting advice. Always check the source.

home.title: Which obligations and deadlines does your business have?
home.lead: Regelvakt shows what your sole proprietorship or limited company must file and pay to the Norwegian Tax Administration and the Brønnøysund Register Centre, and when. Every obligation links to the official page it is based on.
home.step1Text: Regelvakt looks the business up in the Central Coordinating Register for Legal Entities.
home.step2Text: About VAT, salaries and profit: only what the rules need to know.
home.step3Text: With why each obligation applies, a calendar you can subscribe to and reminders by email.

calendar.title: The deadlines in your calendar
calendar.lead: Subscribe to the deadlines in Google Calendar, Outlook or Apple Calendar. The calendar updates itself when the deadlines or the answers change, and every deadline has an alert three days before.
calendar.google: Google Calendar: “Other calendars” → “+” → “From URL”, and paste the address.
calendar.outlook: Outlook: “Add calendar” → “Subscribe from web”, and paste the address.
calendar.apple: Apple Calendar: press “Open in the calendar app”, or “File” → “New Calendar Subscription”.
calendar.privacy: Anyone with the address can see the deadlines. It holds neither your name nor your email address.
calendar.downloadNote: A downloaded file is a copy that is not updated when the deadlines or the answers change. The subscription above stays up to date.

about.title: About Regelvakt
about.lead: Regelvakt shows small businesses which obligations and deadlines they have towards the Norwegian Tax Administration and the Brønnøysund Register Centre, from the organization number and a few answers.
about.why: Knowing which deadlines apply is hard when you start on your own: the VAT return, the a-melding, advance tax, the tax return, the annual accounts. The information exists, but it is spread over many pages and written for everyone. Regelvakt gathers what applies to your business, with the dates for the next twelve months.
about.how: The obligations and deadlines are written as rules in Regelvakt and checked against the pages of the Norwegian Tax Administration and the Brønnøysund Register Centre. Each obligation links to the page it is based on. A deadline on a weekend or public holiday moves to the next business day; the annual accounts stay on 31 July, because the Brønnøysund Register Centre does not say that deadline moves.
about.covers: Sole proprietorships and limited companies. Other organization forms, and obligations that only apply to some industries, are not covered yet.
about.assistant: The assistant answers from Regelvakt's rules and the official pages, and shows where each answer comes from. Questions are not stored, but they are sent to a language model, so do not write personal details in them.
about.not: Regelvakt is not tax or accounting advice, and it is not connected to the Norwegian Tax Administration or the Brønnøysund Register Centre. Always check the source, and talk to an accountant before decisions with financial consequences.
about.project: Regelvakt is under development and made by a full-stack developer in Norway.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: Regelvakt stores as little as possible, and only for as long as it is needed. There are no accounts, no tracking and no ads.
privacy.page: When you look a business up, the organization number, the information about the business from the Central Coordinating Register and your answers are stored, so the page can be shown again from its link. For a sole proprietorship, the information from the register is often the owner's name and address. The page is deleted when you delete it, or by itself when it has not been opened for 30 days and no reminders have been ordered.
privacy.reminders: If you order reminders, the email address, when you want reminders and the language of the emails are stored, with a record of which reminders have been sent, so none is sent twice. An address that is not confirmed is deleted when the confirmation link runs out after 48 hours. Everything is deleted when you stop the reminders or delete the page, and the record of sent reminders is deleted after a year at the latest.
privacy.assistant: Regelvakt does not store the questions to the assistant. To write the answer, the question is sent, together with Regelvakt's rules for the business but without its name, to a language model, which may be run by an outside provider. So do not write personal details in your questions.
privacy.assistantFreeTier: During the trial period, the free version of Google's language model Gemini is used. Google may then use the questions and answers to improve its services, and people at Google may read them.
privacy.others: The organization number is looked up in the Brønnøysund Register Centre's open API. The emails are sent through the email service Resend, which gets the address and the content of the email. No information is sold or given to anyone else.
privacy.cookies: Regelvakt uses only two cookies: one that remembers the language you have chosen, and one that remembers light or dark appearance. Neither is used for tracking, which is why we do not ask for consent.
privacy.counting: We count how many people open each page, with GoatCounter and without cookies. GoatCounter gets the page's address without the organization number and without the code in the link, and what the browser sends with every request, such as the browser type, screen size and IP address. The IP address is used only to find the country and to count each visit once, and is not stored.
privacy.logs: The server writes each request to a log so errors can be found: which page, the answer and the time it took. The content of forms, questions and email addresses is not written to the log. The IP address is used to limit how many requests can come from one address. It is kept only in memory for as long as the limit lasts, an hour at most, and is not written to the log.
privacy.rights: You can delete the page for the business at any time (under “Your answers”) and stop the reminders (from the link in every email). For questions about privacy, get in touch.
privacy.owner: Regelvakt is under development and run by {name}.
